name: io.github.330899935/hive-memory
title: Memory Hive
description: Local-first memory over MCP. Agents propose; only you confirm. Requires the Hive app.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Agent id issued by your own Hive (POST /api/agent/register). The Hive app must be running on the same machine.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Access token issued by your own Hive when the agent is registered.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hive MCP endpoint. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8768/mcp
